standouts.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 13 to Aug 17 (+36%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−3.2% to −8.3%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the May 15 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 25, 2025 to Feb 11 and a pullback of 0.51 of them to the Mar 13 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−15%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+16%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Weekly: wave 4 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: waves 1 to 3 up from Nov 3, 2025 to May 4 (+72%; wave 3 is 1.8 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−6.7% to −11%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the 38.2% retracement of the Mar 16–May 11 drop in the same place. The count is wrong on a daily close under the wave-1 high (−17%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
standouts.learn: After waves 1 to 3 up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.382 and 0.5 retracement of wave 3, above the top of wave 1. A daily close up inside the zone is the buy; a close under the wave-1 high ends the count.

standouts.head: Retesting its breakout level

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range
standouts.text: RSI has stayed above 44 on every dip for three months and reached 69: the range momentum holds in an uptrend.
standouts.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

standouts.head: In a 10-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 10 weeks in a range 17% deep after a +27% advance.
standouts.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

against.head: A bearish engulfing day at a resistance area
against.text: On Oct 23 it opened over the prior close and closed under the prior open at a resistance area: sellers took the day back in full.
against.learn: A session whose body swallows the one before: one side took the day back in full.

against.head: An outside reversal down
against.text: On Oct 23 it traded above the prior high and below the prior low, then closed near its bottom: a key reversal.
against.learn: A session that trades beyond both ends of the day before and closes at an extreme.

against.head: A wide-range day down
against.text: On Oct 23 it covered 2.0x a normal day's range and closed near its low: a decisive day.
against.learn: A session far larger than normal that closes at its extreme: a decisive day.

COKE.take: COKE: it is in an uptrend on every average. Resistance +6.2% overhead leaves too little room from here. The better price is lower, at the June breakout level and the average price paid since the Jul 1 high. It is turning up from its wave-4 zone on the weekly chart, and it is retesting its breakout level. Against it, there is a bearish engulfing day at a resistance area. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
COKE.change: A daily close below −7%, under the average price paid since the Jul 1 high, proves it wrong. The case against, that there is a bearish engulfing day at a resistance area, fails on a daily close above +6.2%, the engulfing day's high.

COLB.gist: A stock at support (the top of its 6-week base); it broke out of a 6-week base.

standouts.head: Broke out of a 6-week base
standouts.text: On Oct 23 it closed above the top of a 6-week base (10% deep), on 2.0x average volume. The break session closed 0.5 ATR past the line on a 1.4-ATR range.
standouts.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

standouts.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 19 to Jul 16 (+31%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−6.9% to −11%), with the Oct 14 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 20, 2025 to Feb 9 and a pullback of 0.66 of them to the Mar 19 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−17%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+9.1%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Heavy buying on Oct 23
standouts.text: On Oct 23 it moved +3.2% on 1.9x its average volume.
standouts.learn: A session's volume against its 50-day average; big moves on heavy volume carry more weight.

standouts.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
standouts.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
standouts.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

standouts.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
standouts.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Oct 2): the run of lower highs is broken.
standouts.learn: When price closes over the last swing high, the run of lower highs ends.

against.head: A descending triangle
against.text: Buyers have held the same floor twice while each bounce stops lower: pressure building on the floor.
against.learn: A flat floor with falling highs: sellers keep taking less.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Aug 24 it closed under the Aug 7 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) are intact.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and a close under the last higher low breaks it.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: On the weekly chart: the pullback from the Jul 13 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually takes three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Apr 7, 2025–Jul 13 advance (−19% to −27%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

COLB.take: COLB: it is back above its averages, and it sits on support at the top of its 6-week base. It broke out of a 6-week base, and it is turning up from its wave-2 zone. Against it, there is a descending triangle. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
COLB.change: A daily close below −1.9%, under the average price paid since the Jul 16 high, proves it wrong.

CZR.gist: A stock pulling back in an uptrend; it sits on support.

standouts.head: Sitting on support
standouts.text: Price sits on the Oct 19 low and the Apr 20 high.
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

standouts.head: Stretched below its 50-day
standouts.text: Price is 3.9 ATR below its 50-day average (−2.5% away), among its widest gaps of the year: moves this stretched tend to pause or snap back.
standouts.learn: How far price sits from its 50-day average in ATR; far stretches tend to pause or snap back.

standouts.head: −6.7% from its 52-week high
standouts.text: Price is −6.7% from its 52-week high and +61% from its 52-week low.
standouts.learn: The highest price of the past year; above it, no one who bought in the last year is waiting to sell at breakeven.

standouts.head: Heavy buying on the rise
standouts.text: Volume on the current rise runs 28% above its 50-day average.
standouts.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: A swing high under the one before and a swing low under the one before: the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: Strong downtrend (ADX 35)
against.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 35, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with sellers in control of the directional lines.
against.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

against.head: Momentum stuck in a bear range
against.text: RSI has failed below 58 on every bounce for three months and fell to 16: the range momentum holds in a downtrend.
against.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

CZR.take: CZR: it is pulling back inside an uptrend. It sits on support, and it is stretched below its 50-day. Against it, its last swing high and low came in under the ones before. The desk stands aside until the chart offers a line to be wrong at.
CZR.change: No plan until the chart offers a line to buy at and be wrong under: a level within reach, a swing low or a base. The case against, that its last swing high and low came in under the ones before, fails on a daily close above +3.4%, the Oct 5 high.
